remarks: A fabulous commuter location within 3 minute walking distance to the Merritt 7 RR station & 1 minute drive to the Merritt & I-95 and seconds from the Wilton line.   Oakwood Commons is a peaceful complex nestled in a private setting featuring well maintained grounds & sparkling in-ground pool. Low HOA. Flexible living room/dining room combination with large windows for natural light and ample space for relaxing, entertaining and home office...and a cozy wood burning fireplace. Spacious bedroom with walk in closet and sliders to private deck. Dont miss the ample private storage room with washer and dryer in lower level. Attached Garage, One assigned parking space for unit, plentiful parking for guests. Up to 2 pets allowed. An extra addition is the pool for your summer fun! Convenient location for all. Near-by restaurants, bars dry-cleaners, gas stations, Walmart, Stop & Shop, medical facilities, Silvermine Golf Club ,Cranbury Park, the Norwalk Beach and much more for you to explore. Don't miss out on this opportunity as it will not last long.
